title: Converge Learn-it Atlas on one learning journey
purpose: Implement the R8 minimum vertical slice selected after Human Replay R7: DERIVED_PROGRESS_GROUPING + EXPLAINED_NEXT_ACTION + PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE. Keep the R7 single Atlas runtime and all persisted semantics unchanged while replacing the opaque first-glance progress encoding on Today with a learner situation statement, explicit why-now copy, and a derived, collapsible objective map grouped as À travailler / À confirmer / Acquis. This is a presentation projection only: no hierarchy is persisted and no planner, scoring, evidence-state, kit-contract, storage or import semantics are changed.
invariants: Atlas learning actions from Today and Library enter the same existing Atlas planner/session engine; no third runtime or learner mode is introduced.
An active Atlas activity hides Today chrome, the classic Library surface, unrelated Atlas course rows and replanning controls while keeping prompt and answers contiguous.
R8 introduces no synthetic percentage, score or persisted learner hierarchy.

R8 progress groups are a presentation-only projection of existing canonical evidence states: validated-recently -> Acquis, ready-for-validation -> À confirmer, and all remaining states -> À travailler.
Canonical evidence states remain not-started, training, review-needed, ready-for-validation and validated-recently; their transitions are unchanged.

The learner-facing next action remains derived from the existing Atlas recommendation action returned by actionForEvidence with the existing recommendation context; recommendation ranking and planner policy are unchanged.
R8 adds an explanatory why-now sentence derived only from the selected objective's existing evidence state; it does not create a second recommendation engine.
Progressive disclosure on Today uses native details/summary semantics and textual group/objective labels, so meaning is not carried by color alone.
The R8 objective map is collapsed by group and therefore does not require rendering all objective details at the first glance; it remains a projection over the complete objective set.
The 5/15/30 planner duration policy is unchanged.
R7 course-scoped final-summary evidence recovery remains unchanged.
Atlas event commits, history, resume state, review-needed semantics, package/course/activity lineage, revision IDs/digests and import behavior are unchanged.
No storage schema, database version, migration, backend, account or sync behavior is introduced.
learnit.kit.v2 and all EPF kit payloads remain unchanged.
Library and final-summary architecture are not broadly redesigned by the R8 minimum vertical slice.
Keyboard/focus behavior remains based on existing Atlas controls and native details/summary, select and button semantics.
requiredEvidence: PR scope validates exactly against ATLAS-WP-024.
Learn-it Next CI runs the bounded atlas-ux-convergence profile on the exact R8 PR head.
The deterministic Learn-it Next source manifest is rebound to every changed manifest-owned source.
The R8 product delta is limited to the Atlas presentation surface, its exact UX clarity regression test, source-manifest rebinding and this work-package authority update.
Static regression evidence proves the R8 derived grouping, learner situation statement, why-now explanation and progressive disclosure are wired without a synthetic percentage.
Existing Atlas core, learning, experience, integration and UX-clarity suites remain green on the exact R8 repository head.
An exact built HTML artifact is produced and bound by bytes and SHA-256 before human replay.
A short R8 Human Replay is prepared to test 5-second comprehension, meaning without color, 20-objective scalability, priority identification and why-now comprehension.
No learner usability PASS is declared by the implementation stream.
adversarialTests: R8 must not modify contracts/learnit-kit-v2.schema.json, authoring payloads, Atlas planner, recommendation, evidence, storage or session lifecycle modules.
R8 must not introduce a percentage, new progress score, persisted objective group or alternate learner runtime.
R8 group labels and objective labels must be present as text, not encoded only by CSS classes or colors.
R8 must keep objective groups under progressive disclosure and must not flatten a 10-20 objective course into an always-expanded dashboard.
R7 ACTIVE_ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND recovery and the multi-course summary path must remain covered by existing exact-head suites.
nonGoals: Changing EPF kits or the learnit.kit.v2 contract.
Creating persistent chapter, group, phase or parent-child objective hierarchy.
Changing Atlas recommendation ranking, planner duration policy, scoring, evidence state transitions or learning-event semantics.
Migrating or merging classic and Atlas storage.
Adding backend, accounts, sync, a theory/discovery mode or a third runtime.
Creating a synthetic mastery percentage, XP, level or gamification system.
Broadly redesigning Library, final summary, navigation or import in this minimum vertical slice.
Adding search, filtering, sorting, shelves, collections, favorites or arbitrary library-management functions.
Using tooltip-only explanations as the primary carrier of progress meaning.
Creating a new contradictory-QA chain or declaring human usability PASS.
independentReview: Issue #352 remains the implementation authority and the driver explicitly requested /audit /solve /build for the R8 minimum vertical slice.
R7 is treated as functionally stabilized: Human Replay R7 resolved ACTIVE_ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND and exact-head CI passed.

The latest completed Human Replay R7 reports that first-glance progress is still insufficient, colors/segments are opaque, 10-20 objectives would not scale, learner wording remains arid and Today versus Library is not yet sufficiently differentiated.
Linus challenge selects a derived presentation projection rather than a new persisted hierarchy, score or planner.
Steve challenge selects a first-glance situation statement plus one explained next action, with objective detail moved behind progressive disclosure.
R8 deliberately starts with Today plus course detail only and leaves broader Library and summary evolution for evidence after the human replay.
The next gate after exact-head machine evidence is human observation; no implementation-owned learner UX PASS is permitted.
rollback: Revert the R8 commit or reset PR #354 to the R7 exact head ec69909e86cf0231cda516ef27487c4b297dd1d1. Persisted state, contracts, kits and Atlas runtime semantics are unchanged.
